{{Quote|Sessar? Madoon, come in! Is anyone there?|Officer Serik|<ref name="STL">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]|Speaking Their Language|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
'''Sessar''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed in the [[High Security Section]] of [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of the [[Blood of Talath]] tribe broke free during a riot and began ambushing [[Prison/Legends|prison]] guards, imitating [[Bird/Legends|bird]] voices for communication. Sessar was one of the guards that fell prey to such attack and failed to respond to a [[Comlink/Legends|comm]] check from officer [[Serik]].
